note: Willacy County publishes no zoning district layer; its GIS offering is parcel shapefiles only. The county seat Raymondville publishes a zoning ordinance PDF and names Planning & Zoning as the map contact, but no queryable zoning polygon service. Lyford and San Perlita showed no zoning GIS. Searches of ArcGIS Online and Hub found no official Willacy zoning layer; the only zoning-carrying parcel data is on commercial aggregators (Regrid), which are not official.
